title: The positions table loses every anti-rug state within 5 seconds: the 5 s positions_update push replaces the whole positions list with rows that carry no anti-rug fields, so every position shows "Unmonitored" and a failed live anti-rug exit ("Exit fired ✗", "consider a manual Force Sell") disappears from the dashboard

evidence.note: positions_update: setPositions(data.positions || []) replaces the whole list
antirug_state_update merges antiRugState / antiRugLastSignals / antiRugLastSuccess into the matching row only; nothing keeps them across the next positions_update
every 5 s (while any dashboard socket is open) the server broadcasts positions_update built by buildPositionsWithLivePrices
the returned position row has tradeId, token, chain, prices, pnl, costs, times, pool and exitState fields only; no antiRugState, antiRugLastSignals or antiRugLastSuccess
antirug_state_update is sent with state 'would-have-sold' (dry-run detection)
antirug_state_update is sent with state 'exit-fired' and success (live exit outcome)
only src/anti-rug/exitTrigger.ts:114 (comment), :207 and :303: the states live, dry-run, halted and unmonitored are never sent, and no other code path sets anti-rug state on a position
the unmonitored tooltip says "No LP baseline recorded for this position. Anti-rug monitoring is not active."
the exit-fired failure tooltip: "the position is still open and a trigger slot was consumed"
EXIT FAILED banner: "The position is still open ... consider a manual Force Sell" (lost with the state)
six badge states are drawn; four of them (Live, Dry-run, Halted (CB), Unmonitored-as-real-state) have no producer

sibling_sites_checked: Every writer of setPositions in the dashboard (useWebSocket.ts:76 REST refresh on connect, :135 positions_update, :177-189 antirug_state_update merge): the first two replace the list from the API row shape (src/api/helpers/positions.ts:151-170), which has no anti-rug fields, so the merge survives at most until the next 5 s broadcast or reconnect. Every producer of antirug_state_update (git grep over src and scripts at the base SHA): exitTrigger.ts:207 and :303 only. Every consumer of the anti-rug fields: PositionTable.tsx:149-152 and :177-183 (badge and tooltip), Overview.tsx:127-135 (detail-modal variant, AUD-DASH-004), AntiRugExitDetailModal.tsx:131-144 (success/failure banner). The same replace-on-push pattern for chain statuses (useWebSocket.ts:147-151) carries no merged fields and is correct. Telegram: exitTrigger.ts sends its own alert only on the dry-run path (:195) and the watchdog-abort path (:288-295); the exit engine's own sell-failure alerts are EXIT-slice and not re-audited here. The anti-rug monitoring gap after a dashboard Stop is AUD-API-002.
severity_rationale: S2 STRAND (indirect): no funds move because of this display defect, but the one dashboard signal that a live anti-rug exit failed and the tokens are still held is wiped within 5 s, and every protected position is labelled "Anti-rug monitoring is not active" while monitored ones and unmonitored ones look identical, so the operator cannot use the dashboard to see which positions lack rug protection or which need a manual sell. Not S1: anti-rug live execute is off by default (dry-run), the bot itself keeps monitoring a failed-held position, and Telegram/log alerts remain. Proven from the base-SHA code alone (row shape, push cadence, replace semantics, the only two producers).
recommendation: Send the anti-rug state (monitor state, last signals, last exit success) inside the server-built position row (from the detector's per-position state) so every positions_update carries it, or merge pushed anti-rug fields by tradeId instead of replacing the list; produce the live, dry-run, halted and unmonitored states for real. Real-path test: fire an exit-fired success=false update, then a positions_update, and assert the badge still shows the failure. Pure bug fix (Phase 29 S2 queue, or with the Phase 24 anti-rug work); nothing changed in Phase 22.

traces.scenario: A live anti-rug exit fails on a held position while the operator has the Overview open
steps: useWebSocket merges it into the row; the badge shows 'Exit fired ✗' and the detail modal shows EXIT FAILED (useWebSocket.ts:177-189; AntiRugStateBadge.tsx:68-72)
at most 5 s later server.ts:186-199 broadcasts positions_update built from helpers/positions.ts:151-170 (no anti-rug fields)
useWebSocket.ts:135 replaces the list; the row's antiRugState is undefined, the badge falls back to 'Unmonitored' (PositionTable.tsx:149)
traces.outcome: The failure indicator is gone within 5 s and the position reads "Anti-rug monitoring is not active" like every other position.
